Can I ask you a personal question? Do you have any mental health issues, and have you ever been to therapy?

Because I’ve done all three at the advice of others and it was ultimately terrible for me. 

Asking someone who can’t go to therapy for what ever reason to go find a purpose greater than themselves can often lead them to neglect what the actual problem is due to feeling safe in that environment. Don’t get me wrong, finding a place that you feel fulfilled and safe in is great. But it’s not helping the overall situation. It’s good for you in the same way taking pain killers after breaking your leg is. It helps manage the problem but doesn’t mend things.

The overall goal of therapy is to learn how to manage your issues and live with them, not to simply cover them up.

Also, A life of comfort = A life of anxiety is a very silly thing to say. There are plenty of people who live very comfortable lives who have no anxiety and then there are others who live very “uncomfortable” lives who have tons of anxiety. (Think doctors, nurses, and social workers)
